unscored: A sign that cannot be scored, or a refused rating, is stored as unscored, never as 0.
scoring: Score each sign at the patch where that sign is strongest. A patch is at least about the size of a fingertip; a single small spot is ignored, but many small spots close together count as a patch. Different signs may be scored on different patches. If no patch shows a sign, score it 0. How much of the area is affected is not part of the sign scores.

levels.1: Barely perceptible; light pink on lighter skin
levels.3: Deep, dark, or fiery bright red

signs.name: Dryness or flaking
signs.lookFor: White or light flakes and scales lifting from the surface. Skin lines alone are not dryness, even when deepened; deepened lines are thickening.

levels.0: Smooth, no flakes; only normal skin lines
levels.1: Dull, slightly rough surface, with faint fine scaling seen only up close
levels.2: Clearly visible small white flakes, with a few larger ones; a whitish look
levels.3: Larger scales or peeling across the patch, often with redness or small cracks

signs.name: Bumps or blisters
signs.lookFor: Separate small raised bumps or fluid-filled blisters, including tiny deep blisters on the fingers and palms that look like grains under the skin. Judge how many there are and how large. Puffiness without separate bumps is swelling, not this sign.

levels.1: Fewer than 2 per area the size of a small fingernail
levels.2: 2 to 8 per area the size of a small fingernail
levels.3: More than 8 per area the size of a small fingernail, or large blisters

sources.note: HECSI scores blisters separately from swelling.
HECSI rater instructions: blisters are judged by size and density.
DASI blister density grades per square centimetre.

signs.name: Scratch marks
signs.lookFor: Lines, scrapes, or small wounds from scratching. Cracks from dry skin belong to dryness.

levels.1: A few superficial scratch marks, spread out
levels.2: Many superficial scratch marks, or a few deeper ones

signs.name: Thickening
signs.lookFor: Skin that is thicker and tougher, so its natural lines are exaggerated into a criss-cross pattern. It builds up over weeks and does not look puffy.

levels.1: Slight thickening, skin lines only slightly exaggerated
levels.2: Clearly thickened, with exaggerated skin lines
levels.3: Thickened skin lines that form deep furrows

sources.note: SCORAD names this sign but publishes no level wording; the levels are this project's own.

signs.name: Swelling
signs.lookFor: Puffiness from fluid under the skin: the area looks fuller than the same area on a clear day, the skin looks smooth or stretched, and creases and fine lines fade. It can appear anywhere. Separate raised bumps are not swelling.

levels.2: Clearly puffy; creases fade and outlines look rounder
levels.3: Marked swelling that changes the shape of the area

sources.note: HECSI scores swelling as its own sign.
HECSI rater instructions compare the area with the same area when clear. The level wording is this project's own.
Validates dermatologists rating smartphone photos; it does not validate AI ratings or the wording of these definitions.
